tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0014", "detail": "Line 1 'Double Wall Carton 40x40x40' is ordered at unit price 13900 (14 units), but the invoice bills 15100.00 per unit."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-014#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of the Agreement; no Schedule A price of 15100 exists."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-014#2.2", "detail": "A unit price change takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties and never retroactively, so the 15100 has no contractual basis."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV-SPL-00176", "detail": "Bills 14 x 15100.00 = 211400.00 on line 1 instead of 14 x 13900 = 194600.00."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0014", "detail": "All 14 units of the carton were received on 2026-09-10; the quantity is correct, only the price is above the PO."}, {"kind": "vendor", "ref": "V-014", "detail": "No earlier ledger invoice of this vendor bills cartons at 15100 — prior invoices INV-SPL-00165, INV-SPL-00155, INV-SPL-00145 and INV-SPL-00190 relate to other purchase orders."}], "explanation": "The invoice charges 15100.00 per carton against a PO price of 13900 that the contract fixes in Schedule A with no addendum allowing an increase, so the price difference is an overcharge."}]}
